title: Universal localization of the explicit linear scalar cone
statement: Using the scalar-multiplication arrow interface of [lem-coef-strict-normalized-adic-cone-limit], for a ring R, an R-linear abelian category A with a derived category, and a scalar s : R, define cochain to send X to Cone(s times the identity of X), and a chain map to the diagonal cone map. The localized functor derived is the universal localization of cochain followed by Q at quasi-isomorphisms. The comparison is its canonical factorization isomorphism Q followed by derived to cochain followed by Q. Quasi-isomorphism invariance is proved by the mapping-cone distinguished triangles and two-isomorphisms property. For a strict normalized tower T and exponent n, augmentation is explicitly rho followed by desc and the normalized cokernel descent on T_(m+n). Its localized form derivedAugmentation is the canonical factorization comparison followed by Q of augmentation.
